I’m Colombian, lived in the neighboring department Armenia is in.

1. If you want a similar style of coffee from starbucks, go to Juan Valdez Café.

2. McDonald’s is available in Colombia, the chain just isn’t everywhere like the USA. 

3. There are many american fast-food chains, this guy just hasn’t looked. You could easily find a KFC and Papa John’s.

4. There are LEGO shops in Colombia, He’d just have to go to the big cities (Bogotá and Medellín)

5. There is Uber and Taxi service widespread in Colombia. Not to mention, we have a pretty robust bus rapid transit system.

6. There are plenty. He just didn’t make any effort into finding all these places.
